title: Rewinding to the Origin
statement: For every bit-list input $x$, valid input-head position $p$, bit list $w$, and natural number $j$ with $j\leq |w|$, running the increment machine for $j+1$ steps from rewind control, with input head at $p$, work head at the integer cell $j-1$, tape holding $w$, and empty output, ends in return control. The resulting input-head position is $p$, the work head is at cell $0$, the tape still holds $w$, and the output is empty.
hypotheses_covered: $p$ is a valid input-head position for $x$
replaced: For every input word, input position, stored word $w$, and count $j \le |w|$, running the increment machine in rewind control at cell $j - 1$ for $j + 1$ steps crosses the written cells, detects the untouched blank at cell $-1$, and ends at cell $0$ in the absorbing return control, with the stored word unchanged.
